notes: 8 configurations of 7 machines from 6 manufacturers (Oxford Cryosystems, Anton Paar, Martin Christ, Syrris, Montana Instruments, Bruker BioSpin), none already in data/cryostats (catalog already has Labconco FreeZone 6, Linkam DSC600/THMS600, Retsch CryoMill/MM400, Neslab RTE740, Oxford OptistatDry). All sources accessed 2026-11-01. Absences (install=not_available, value unknown) are backed by quotes of the complete specification/technical-data tables or intended-use statements. Celsius converted exactly to mK; pressures kept in printed units (mbar) or exact Pa (bar x 100000; TTK '2 bar above atmospheric' stored as 200000 Pa gauge, conservative). Freeze dryers: temperature.range is the SHELF range; Christ 2-6D condenser stored as the conservative -85 C (brochure also prints -88 C); Christ optical_access assumes the transparent acrylic door named in configuration_basis. Cryostream sample.diameter/height use the manual's 'centre 2 mm of the gas stream' positioning rule (sample < 1 mm3). Bruker 9.4 T field and LHe magnet cooling come from a University of Rostock facility page describing the Ascend 400 DNP magnet (reference_data). Quotes from tables use '...' to join a row label and its value where the PDF layout separates them. Not completed: TA Instruments DSC 2500 (tainstruments.com PDFs timed out), SPEX 6875 Freezer/Mill (magnetically driven impactor with undocumented field, no temperature value), ARS matrix-isolation cryostats (no complete spec sheet found), ULT freezers (covered by other industry agents).
